notes: 0015: adds a single explicit account picker for all existing monitoring rules, preserving active batches and preventing later accounts from joining those rules automatically. Persists successful target resolution and membership per account/auth session to avoid repeated invite/join checks across restarts; reuses exact-policy admin assignments and prepares only unknown accounts. Zero cache TTL means no expiry. Access errors invalidate only the affected account/target; manual cache reset remains available. Includes scan/edit race, failed-join and real Telethon serialization checks.
